There are two ways to run the tests, both through `make`:

- **`make test-fast`** runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`. It skips the Postgres integration tests, so it needs no database. Use it for day-to-day work.
- **`make test`** runs the full suite with `pytest -q`. It includes the Postgres-marked tests, which need a database. Start one first with `docker compose up db`. Without it, those tests fail on connection errors.
